about.description: TMF is a bond fund perpetual listed on BingX, tracking Direxion Daily 20+ Year Treasury Bull 3X ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
